problems: The tilt k.turn(22, 22, 0) tips the dome toward the camera so far that the canopy hides the wooden shaft. Only the crook handle shows below the lace, so the card loses the named wooden shaft and the parasol reads as a lampshade or a cap. Fix: tilt it mostly sideways and only a little toward the camera so the shaft shows under the canopy.

The lace ruffle has 48 waves on a 192-vertex lathe, only 4 vertices per wave, so it renders as a jagged sawblade instead of soft ruffles. Fix: raise the lathe to 480 vertices and use fewer, softer waves.
